config.arms: narrow/expanded x scalar/block/shared x untrained/final finite-causal selector
config.geometry: Refit rank128 perport PCA on unique training prompts within family, equal family weights and equal prompt weights, uniform tokens within prompt. Train-only center/global scalar normalization perport.
config.optimization: Exact H1033 Selector class, Adam0.03,80fixed pair steps, family round-robin,1e-4importance penalty, clamp[-2,2]. Same compute not same per-family exposures: narrow16 versus expanded8 visits/family.
config.scope: Fixed random partitions of PCA coordinates;384learned importance values, not learned semantic memberships or a full learned featurizer. Single seed pilot.
config.capacity: 128dictionary atoms perstream,16active max perstream,48total; shared unions may use fewer.
config.objective: Mean native-to-reconstruction KL plus mean full-donor-to-decoded-difference-patch KL, both directions. Native suffix only for supervision/evaluation.
config.evaluations: Opened same-family19pairs, historical excluded16pairs, adaptively screened weekday4pairs. No fresh-task generalization claim.
